title: [Salty's Services, Containers]
description: Samples of wood and stone are cluttered alongside a small raised platform to one side of the area.  Upon this platform, a tired half-elf vendor stands, surveying the merchandise and watching passers-by.  Alongside the vendor is a sturdy-looking wicker chair and several votives that light the platform.  Surrounding the platform, and next to the example wood planks and stone slabs, are completed pieces of furniture for sale, including racks, tables, and other displays.
